bullets.text: Gathers and frames business requirements with product and operations teams, then designs and builds the corresponding solution: data model, semantic layer, reports, security roles.
Administers Power BI Service: workspace structure, app publishing, deployment pipelines across Dev / Test / Prod, gateway configuration, refresh scheduling.
Builds the data layer on Microsoft Fabric: Lakehouse ingestion, medallion architecture, Direct Lake semantic models feeding dashboards used in management reviews.
Star-schema data modelling; performance tuning through query folding, aggregation tables, incremental refresh.
Owns role and permission design: defines which population accesses which data perimeter, implements it as security roles, validates before release.
Escalation point for access and authorization requests from business users.
Writes automated extraction and preparation jobs in Python and Java; REST API integration from operational sources.
Participates in architecture reviews and argues technical trade-offs.
Agile / Scrum ceremonies; continuous delivery through GitLab CI.
Ran requirements workshops with business, operations and IT stakeholders; produced functional specifications, data models, KPI definitions; validated through user acceptance testing.
Delivered 15+ Power BI solutions across 12 Scrum sprints - DAX measures, Power Query transformations, static and dynamic row-level security - published to governed workspaces.
Built and maintained ETL pipelines; integrated internal ERP and CRM sources over REST APIs including HubSpot; data quality controls that measurably reduced recurring inconsistencies.
Administered Azure AD / Entra ID, SSO and Active Directory: user and group administration, role assignment, periodic permission reviews.
Applied fine-grained authorization: static and dynamic row-level security, object-level security, so each business scope was restricted to its own perimeter.
Enforced data segregation between client perimeters - a contractual requirement in banking and insurance.
Administered Windows Server and VMware vSphere.

Java 8+ backend development on the Palmyra framework: PML model definition, xmlToJava code generation, Maven plugin automation (generation, Swagger, release) across a large banking and insurance software suite.
Build engineering with Maven and Tycho: OSGi bundles, Eclipse plugin packaging, p2 repositories, dependency and multi-environment configuration management.
GitLab CI pipeline diagnostics and build-failure resolution; code quality with SonarQube.
Automated functional testing with Playwright and Selenium, including test-data generation scripts; SQL validation on MySQL.
First-level user support through Jira: incident triage, reproduction, SQL root-cause investigation, resolution or escalation, follow-up to closure, user training.
Customer upsell analytics pipeline on CRM and billing data; feature engineering in Python; predictive modelling with scikit-learn.
Power BI dashboards tracking campaign KPIs and customer segment profitability.

projects.name: SIMEG - integrated business platform (graduation project)
bullets: Six-module platform: CRM, HR, Finance, Inventory, Project Management, Reporting. 4 releases, 12 Scrum sprints.
Spring Boot backend, Angular frontend, REST APIs documented with Swagger / OpenAPI.
OAuth2 authentication via Google and Azure AD; role-based access per module.
Relational data model; embedded Power BI reporting module.
